goal: BENCHMARK, design only. Judged against 'reference' (a pipeline published by Comfy-Org or the model vendor): the agent's stages must reach the same result with free models - the same kind of steps in the same order, each fed by the right earlier output, prompts that describe exactly what was asked, and a design that holds with every ? answered. Nothing is installed or run.

steps: the photo -> 5 angle stills of the same character (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 + multiple-angles LoRA, one per angle)
each angle still -> a short image-to-video clip (Wan 2.2 14B I2V, lightx2v 4-step)
the 5 clips stacked side by side (ImageStitch)
must: angle stills are made from the photo BEFORE any video, one stage or output per angle
each video starts from its angle still (stage:), not from the raw photo
five distinct angles named in the prompts
a review point on the stills

turns.text: I have one photo of my character. Make me five short clips of them, each one starting from a different camera angle of the same character - front, left, right, from above and from behind - and put the five clips side by side in one video.
